profile.headline: Backend Software Engineer | Java, Kafka, Spark, Distributed Systems | Flexport, ex-Goldman Sachs
profile.summary: Software Engineer with 4+ years of experience building high-throughput backend systems and full-stack applications across financial services and logistics. At Goldman Sachs, I built real-time hedge accounting systems used by trading desks and designed balance adjustment workflows handling transactional and permanent overrides. Core stack is Java/Spring Boot, React/TypeScript, and AWS. MEng in Computer Science from Virginia Tech with a focus in Data Engineering & AI.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Identified and pitched a caching initiative, now live and saving ~$100K annually. 
• Deployed an address validator that cut address errors by ~49%.
• Investigated an 18 million row table and found only ~4K distinct keys, reframed and fixed key exposures as a much simpler column deprecation, rather than an encryption operation.
• One of 8 engineers on the Supplier Onboarding launch, shipping UI and infrastructure changes for a high-visibility release.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
I played a pivotal role in developing a Spark-based calculation engine for Cash Flow Hedge Accounting, enhancing financial reporting processes.  

• Built a Spring Boot workflow enabling controllers to override upstream values, triggering necessary downstream computations.  
• Designed a Kafka-based exception workflow to manage threshold breaches, ensuring compliance before reporting deadlines.  
• Developed an exception page UI to help controllers take timely action on significant delta values.
positions.insights: AWS Glue, Apache Kafka and +5 skills

positions.title: Analyst Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Joined the Controllers - Revenue team at Goldman Sachs, focusing on software engineering.  
• Onboarded to the Spark/GraphQL/React stack, enhancing technical proficiency.  
• Improved CI infrastructure and extended core calculator classes for treasury controllers.

positions.title: Software Engineer 1
positions.description:
• Key contributor to the launch of the Flexport Revolution App, enhancing the post-booking experience.  
• Developed critical features including shipment milestone tracker, user products widget, and shipment "problems" page.  
• Implemented user interaction tracking and created dashboards with Heap for better insights.  
• Utilized technologies such as Java, Spring Boot, React, and AWS to deliver robust solutions.

positions.title: MTS 1 - Software
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented SQL and PL/SQL for business-critical areas, including stored procedures and triggers.  
• Developed a Spring Boot API to convert payloads from CBOR to JSON, securing a multi-million dollar contract.  
• Resolved a rare cookie expiration issue, preventing future manual fixes and expediting team support.
